$comment: Machine-readable component manifest for agent consumers (DS-6, PRO-232; grew the PRO-231 ds-6-draft stub in place). Validated by scripts/check-manifest.mjs (pnpm manifest:check); llms.txt is GENERATED from this file by scripts/build-llms.mjs (pnpm build:llms) — edit here, then regenerate. `kind` is one of component | composable | util | data | skip. `skip` entries are Every Layout primitives the layer deliberately does NOT ship, so agents that know the book don't reintroduce them.
name: @ccm/ds
description: CCM design-system Nuxt layer: Nuxt UI v4 + Utopia fluid tokens + Every Layout composition components + domain foundations.
doctrine: Pages compose components — a page file wires existing Nuxt UI and Ccm components together; it does not build widgets or layouts out of raw markup and utility soup.
Class strings live only inside Tailwind Variants definitions (component files). Outside components/, class attributes are budgeted by lint (ccm/class-budget); pass props, not classes.
Nuxt UI is restyled through app.config.ts (`ui` key) only — never inline :ui props, never scattered CSS overrides.
ccm-layer CSS is plain CSS written on the design tokens (var(--spacing-*), var(--text-step-*), var(--color-*)) — no raw hex, no raw px (Stylelint enforces this).
@apply is reserved for prose/markdown styling — never use it to build components.

entries.name: CcmStack
entries.description: Every Layout Stack (ch. 01): injects block-start margins between stacked siblings via the owl selector — spacing belongs to the context, not the elements.
entries.whenToUse: Vertical rhythm between any run of siblings: page sections, form fields, article flow. Reach for this instead of `flex flex-col gap-*` outside components/.

props.name: as
props.description: Element (or component) to render.

props.name: space
props.description: Utopia space token between siblings.

props.name: recursive
props.description: Apply the spacing at any nesting depth, not only to direct children.

props.name: splitAfter
props.description: Push everything after the nth child to the block-end edge (auto margin). Invalid values are ignored with a console warning.

antiPatterns: Adding vertical margins to the children — the Stack owns the spacing.
Rebuilding it as `flex flex-col gap-*` in a page — compose CcmStack instead.
splitAfter outside 1-5 — the CSS only enumerates five positions.

entries.name: CcmCluster
entries.description: Every Layout Cluster (ch. 04): a wrapping flex row for groups of variable-length items spaced with gap.
entries.whenToUse: Tag lists, button groups, nav links, metadata rows — anything that should wrap naturally when it runs out of inline space.

props.name: as
props.description: Element (or component) to render.

props.name: space
props.description: Utopia space token for the gap.

props.name: justify
props.description: CSS justify-content value.

props.name: align
props.description: CSS align-items value.

antiPatterns: Single-file horizontal scroll strips — that is CcmReel.
Two-pane layouts that should switch orientation at a width — that is CcmSwitcher.

entries.name: CcmGrid
entries.description: Every Layout Grid (ch. 08): auto-filling column grid via `minmax(min(<min>, 100%), 1fr)` — container-intrinsic in pure CSS, single column below the minimum, no media queries.
entries.whenToUse: Card grids and galleries where the column count should follow the container, not viewport breakpoints.

props.name: as
props.description: Element (or component) to render.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum column width; default set in CSS to a third of the measure.

props.name: space
props.description: Utopia space token for the gap.

antiPatterns: Fixed column counts (`grid-cols-3` + breakpoint variants) for content that should be container-intrinsic.
Passing a token name as `min` — it takes a CSS length (e.g. '15rem'), not a SpaceToken.

entries.name: CcmReel
entries.description: Every Layout Reel (ch. 10): a single-file flex row that scrolls horizontally on overflow with native scrollbar affordance. No JavaScript.
entries.whenToUse: Browsable strips — card rows, image rails, slidable link bars — where native continuous scrolling is the whole interaction.

props.name: as
props.description: Element (or component) to render.

props.name: space
props.description: Utopia space token between items.

props.name: itemWidth
props.description: Width for each item; 'auto' leaves items their intrinsic width.

props.name: height
props.description: Block-size for the reel; 'auto' tracks the tallest item.

props.name: noBar
props.description: Hide the scrollbar (for a11y-neutral strips like link bars).

antiPatterns: Paged sliding with dots/arrows/autoplay/snap points — that is Nuxt UI's UCarousel, not CcmReel.
Adding JS scroll hijacking on top — native overflow scrolling is the contract.

entries.name: CcmSwitcher
entries.description: Every Layout Switcher (ch. 06), implemented with container queries (PRO-229 deviation from the book's flex-basis hack). Switches between horizontal and vertical flex at a container-based breakpoint.
entries.whenToUse: Rows that must stack when their CONTAINER (not the viewport) gets narrow: media-object pairs, action bars, side-by-side panels.

props.name: as
props.description: Element (or component) to render.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Named container breakpoint below which children stack (xs=20rem, s=30rem, m=40rem, l=50rem, xl=60rem). Enumerated because @container size conditions cannot read custom properties.

props.name: space
props.description: Utopia space token for the gap.

props.name: limit
props.description: Quantity threshold: with more than this many children the layout stays vertical regardless of width.

antiPatterns: Passing a free CSS length as threshold — only the xs–xl names exist.
Viewport media queries for component-level layout switches — the whole point is container-based.

entries.name: CcmCover
entries.description: Every Layout Cover (ch. 07): a min-height column with one principal element vertically centered via auto block margins, optionally book-ended by header/footer children. Default min height 100svh.
entries.whenToUse: Viewport-height heroes and cover screens: heading centered, optional bar above and call-to-action below.

props.name: as
props.description: Element (or component) to render.

props.name: space
props.description: Utopia space token between/around children.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum block size of the cover.

props.name: noPad
props.description: Drop the padding on the container element.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Children; the centered one is the `h1` or any child carrying the `data-cover-centered` attribute.

antiPatterns: Centering one box inside another — that is `grid place-items-center`, not a Cover.
Forgetting the principal element: without an h1 or data-cover-centered child nothing centers.

entries.name: CcmFrame
entries.description: Every Layout Frame (ch. 09): holds any child to a fixed aspect ratio; replaced children (img/video) fill and crop via object-fit, anything else is centered and clipped.
entries.whenToUse: Media in cards and previews that must keep a fixed aspect ratio regardless of the source dimensions.

props.name: as
props.description: Element (or component) to render.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Aspect ratio as 'width:height', e.g. '16:9', '4:5', '1:1'. Typed because untyped ratios produced repeated 4:5 cover-crop bugs in Social House.

props.name: fit
props.description: How replaced children fill the frame: 'cover' crops, 'contain' letterboxes.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The framed child (usually an img or video).

antiPatterns: Overriding object-fit in CSS instead of passing `fit`.
Malformed ratios — anything not 'W:H' falls back to 16:9 with a console warning.

entries.name: CcmChannelBadge
entries.description: Brand-colored channel badge (icon + label) driven by the channel registry.
entries.whenToUse: Labelling content with its social platform anywhere a compact branded chip fits.

props.name: channel
props.description: Channel name, free-form (e.g. 'instagram', 'Twitter'); alias-aware, unknown values fall back to neutral.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label override (platform names are proper nouns — rarely needed).

antiPatterns: Hardcoding platform hex colors — brand color comes from the channels registry, the sanctioned token exception.

entries.name: CcmChannelIcon
entries.description: Channel id -> platform SVG mark (alias-aware; neutral globe fallback).
entries.whenToUse: Rendering a platform mark on its own, without the badge chrome.

props.name: channel
props.description: Channel name, free-form (e.g. 'instagram', 'Twitter').

entries.name: CcmStatusBadge
entries.description: Status badge rendering the STATUS_COLORS mechanism via themed --ui-* variables.
entries.whenToUse: Showing content workflow state (draft/pending/published/…) as a badge. The single status→color mechanism — never map status to color anywhere else.

props.name: status
props.description: Status id, free-form ('published', 'In Buffer', 'draft'); normalized internally.

props.name: label
props.description: Already-translated label override (takes precedence over `locale`).

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the built-in dictionaries (en/pt).

antiPatterns: Per-status CSS forks or ad-hoc status→color maps in consuming apps — STATUS_COLORS in app/utils/status.ts is the single source.

entries.name: CcmIconInstagram
entries.description: Instagram SVG mark (currentColor).

entries.name: CcmIconLinkedin
entries.description: LinkedIn SVG mark (currentColor).

entries.name: CcmIconX
entries.description: X (Twitter) SVG mark (currentColor).

entries.name: CcmIconFacebook
entries.description: Facebook SVG mark (currentColor).

entries.name: CcmIconYoutube
entries.description: YouTube SVG mark (currentColor).

entries.name: CcmIconTiktok
entries.description: TikTok SVG mark (currentColor).

entries.name: CcmIconGoogleMyBusiness
entries.description: Google G mark (fixed multi-color fills; internal-onboarding use only per Google brand guidelines).

entries.name: CcmIconBluesky
entries.description: Bluesky SVG mark (currentColor).

entries.name: useClipboard
entries.description: Composable wrapper over copyToClipboard preserving the `const { copy } = useClipboard()` call-site shape.

entries.name: channels
entries.description: Social-channel registry: {label, brandColor, fg, monochrome, icon} per platform (8: instagram, linkedin, x, facebook, youtube, tiktok, google_my_business, bluesky) + resolveChannel/channelBrand/channelIds. Sole home of brand hex (sanctioned token exception).
antiPatterns: Hardcoding platform brand hex anywhere else — this file is the only sanctioned hex location.

entries.name: status
entries.description: Status conventions: STATUS_COLORS map (status id -> semantic color: success/info/warning/error/neutral) as the single badge-coloring mechanism, plus EN/PT label dictionaries (STATUS_MESSAGES), statusColor/statusLabel/statusLabelKey/normalizeStatus/statusIds.

entries.name: formatDate
entries.description: Locale-aware, UTC-stable date formatter (Intl-based, no date-fns). formatDate(value, { locale, style }) — defensive: empty -> '', unparseable strings pass through.

entries.name: copyToClipboard
entries.description: Framework-agnostic clipboard write: navigator.clipboard with hidden-textarea/execCommand fallback. Never throws; resolves boolean.

entries.name: composition
entries.description: Shared prop types/guards for the composition components: SPACE_TOKENS (the 9 Utopia steps + 8 one-step pairs), spaceVar(), SWITCHER_THRESHOLDS (xs=20rem…xl=60rem), FrameRatio parsing. SpaceToken values: 3xs 2xs xs s m l xl 2xl 3xl 3xs-2xs 2xs-xs xs-s s-m m-l l-xl xl-2xl 2xl-3xl.

entries.name: Icon
entries.description: Every Layout's Icon layout (icon-to-text sizing/alignment) is deliberately not shipped.
entries.useInstead: UIcon (Nuxt UI + Iconify) for general icons; the layer only ships brand marks via CcmChannelIcon.

entries.name: Imposter
entries.description: Every Layout's Imposter (positioned overlay) is deliberately not shipped — overlays are widget territory: focus traps, dismissal, ARIA.
entries.useInstead: UModal for dialogs, UPopover for anchored overlays.

entries.name: Box
entries.description: Every Layout's Box (padded/bordered container) is deliberately not shipped — a component wrapper adds nothing over one or two token-backed utilities.
entries.useInstead: Utility classes on the design tokens (e.g. p-s, border, rounded-sm) or UCard when it is card-shaped.

entries.name: Center
entries.description: Every Layout's Center (measured horizontal centering with gutters) is deliberately not shipped.
entries.useInstead: UContainer for page-width centering; `mx-auto max-w-*` or `grid place-items-center` for one-off intrinsic centering.

entries.name: Container
entries.description: No bespoke width-container component. Component-responsive behavior belongs to container queries, not wrapper components.
entries.useInstead: UContainer for the page shell; CSS container queries (the CcmSwitcher pattern) when a component must respond to its own width.

entries.name: Sidebar
entries.description: Every Layout's Sidebar (sidebar-with-content pair) is deferred, not rejected — no consuming product needs it yet.
entries.useInstead: CcmSwitcher or a grid for now; when a sidebar pattern recurs (2+ real uses across consuming apps), extract it into the layer as CcmSidebar per the extraction rule.
